text: Sector Four's still ticking like a bomb — Vale drops the "displacement" bomb again, but Dusk doubles down: it's the broken ventilation shafts draining energy, not the people, and drags Vale off to cross-check the data instead of giving up on the sector. Lumen's tea party AND wildflower ideas get shot down twice, but Dusk swoops in with a peace offering — a big stew dinner at the Yard, and Lumen's in, honey cakes and all. Meanwhile Mrs. Elara's water pump just jumped the repair line ahead of Flint's precious press seals, and Reed's still playing peacemaker, tending tomatoes, hauling basil seedlings, and angling to dig through Dusk's Gamma logs himself so nobody has to choose between fixing pipes and losing their home.
